title: Factory host profile
description: Where one host keeps the bundle and its working directories, and what it changes in the instance. Keys starting with _ are notes.

name.description: The host's name, recorded in the bundle's manifest.

runtime.description: Which hosting/<runtime>/history.py keeps this host's run records and leases. Defaults to the name.

paths.description: Paths on the machine that runs the bundle, written into prompts as {{host.<key>}}. A profile may add its own. The checkout, worktree root and state directory are kept beside the bundle, never inside it: every render replaces the bundle.

bundle.description: Where the bundle is installed, as an absolute path: the harness config and the prompts carry it as written.

checkout.description: A clone of the repo that the factory owns. Agent workers run in it.

stateDir.description: Where a worker keeps state between runs, and where the local host keeps run records and leases.

python.description: The Python that runs the bundle's scripts. Defaults to python3.

env.description: The environment variables a run keeps, by name, on top of PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, LANG, LC_*, TMPDIR, TZ, every FACTORY_* and those the harness declares. List what the agent's credentials, the code host CLI, the integrations and the repo's build read, such as KIRO_API_KEY, GH_TOKEN, AWS_PROFILE or AWS_REGION, SSH_AUTH_SOCK and a toolchain's JAVA_HOME. Without this key a run keeps the whole environment it is started in.

integrationOverrides.description: Integration values merged over the instance's, for what only this host has, such as a secret file's path.

workerOverrides.description: Per-worker values merged over the instance's, such as a schedule. A worker the instance does not have is skipped.
